decisions.briefing: Markets drifted lower today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.4%) in a neutral, low-conviction session. With cash at $489.29 — just under the $500 deployment threshold — and no strong risk-on signal, we're holding all 7 positions and sitting on cash rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices slipped modestly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, reflecting a quiet, directionless trading session rather than any major catalyst. There was no single dominant headline driving the move — price action looked like routine consolidation after recent gains. Volume and momentum signals across the screened universe remained mixed, with several names still in bullish RSI zones but no broad-based breakout.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，那斯達克指數下跌0.3%，標普500指數下跌0.4%，並無明顯的重大消息面驅動，較像是近期漲勢後的正常整理。篩選名單中的動能訊號依然參差不齊，部分股票RSI仍處於偏多區間，但未見全面性的突破行情。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on hand, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears, rather than being invested just for the sake of staying fully invested. Today our cash balance sat just below the $500 deployment threshold on a neutral market day, so the disciplined move is to hold that cash rather than force a buy.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是手上保留的現金，等待真正出現強烈訊號時才出手，而不是為了「把錢用完」而勉強進場。今天現金餘額剛好低於500美元的部署門檻，加上市況中性，因此紀律上應該繼續持有現金，等待更明確的進場時機。
